reason: When I'm in Honolulu I already have my Korean place on Keeaumoku and I go there. I can get Yu Chun naengmyeon back in Japan, so I don't see why I'd use a meal on my trip here, especially at $18.95 for cold noodles.
objection: I've heard the Japanese branches are just as good, so why go here instead of my usual spot or waiting until I'm home.
would_change_my_mind: Something only this Honolulu location has, like a Hawaii-only dish, that I can't get at the Japanese branches.
